help_text:
👋 Hi! I'm your Cross Border Assistant. I can:
• Convert currencies — 'convert 100 USD to CNY'
• Show your budget — 'how is my budget?'
• Set rate alerts — 'alert me when USD/CNY above 7.3'
• Check tuition — 'when is my tuition due?'
• Compare transfer methods — 'cheapest way to send 500 USD to CNY'
• Give step-by-step guides — 'guide me through paying tuition'
• Build credit — 'how do I build credit?'
• Forecast spending — 'will I exceed my budget?'
• Optimize tuition FX timing — 'should I pay my tuition now?'
• Track your FX quota — 'check my FX quota'
• Import a bank statement — 'import my statement.csv'
• Open the web UI — 'open the web ui'
import_help: To import a bank statement, export it as CSV and tell me the file path — e.g. 'import my statement.csv'. I'll show a preview first; nothing is written without your confirmation.
import_preview_header: 📄 Preview of {path}: {total} row(s), {skipped} skipped. Nothing was written yet.
serve_help: To use the web dashboard, run: `python cba/cli.py serve --port 8000` and open http://localhost:8000 in your browser.
suggest_optimize: check FX timing for my tuition
transfer_format_help: Tell me like: 'cheapest way to send 500 USD to CNY'.
tuition_none: No tuition bills on file. Add one and I'll remind you before it's due!
